en: Colorized panoramic view of a historic European city with red-roofed houses and public buildings nestled around a wooded hill, beyond which lie soft, rolling mountains. Atop the hill and nearby elevations are small pavilion-like lookout structures. The caption in German at the top identifies the scene as a view of Graz from the Hilmwarte. Additional small print at the upper right edge indicates the publisher and city.
